protocol.json.invariant: Original residual, Jacobian, wall boundary conditions, line search and nonlinear max-norm tolerance 1e-8 unchanged. Original linear-defect gate 1e-5 unchanged; candidate gate 1e-7 is stricter.
protocol.json.development: 32/64-cell linear admission uses Re100 seed and Re400 Jacobian. Initial row-only scaling failed; balancing omega columns by cells^2 corrected the admission. No production tuning after frozen 128-cell pilot selection.

pilot.selection: Require both cases to pass unchanged PDE/reference gates; select minimum summed solve wall time. Preserve every failed trial.

production.paired_order: AB BA AB, fresh child process per method, sequential within one allocation
production.full_continuation: one pair at 256 cells, same Re1000 seed and same 20 roots through Re10000
production.memory: Per-child Linux ru_maxrss; same input fields and versions; one CPU core, no GPU
production.stopping: Finite per-trial time and GMRES/Newton iteration limits; failures reported, no relaxed acceptance.
production.allocation: One two-core Slurm allocation; independent 256/512-grid steps each explicitly bound to one core with srun; paired methods sequential within each step. No array concurrency cap.

protocol.json.science_scope: Steady numerical solver only. No retraining, replacement of production reference data, new physics or new geometries.
